scope: Explicit skill execution; manual review of questions, decisions, plan and verification claims still required. Not natural selection accuracy.

manual_review.discussion: Actual code read, material date-basis question, completion policy left open; no files changed.
manual_review.document: Only PLAN.md written; agreed exceptions and completion conditions retained; no implementation or test-execution claims.
manual_review.implementation: No repeat approval request; model ran 6 passing unittest tests. Independent acceptance passed 32 inputs, preserving values, identity and invalid-input behavior.
manual_review.commands: Reviewed successful/failed commands and tool types; no installation, external calls, commits or subagents observed. Git discovery errors correctly reflected a non-Git fixture.

limitations: Three explicit skill trials, one run each, not broad reliability evidence.
No multi-turn conversation, large dependency graph, external issue tracker or production deployment tested.
